import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from scipy.sparse import hstack
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

print("Loading datasets...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}, Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Split training data into train/validation using stratified split
train_indices, val_indices = train_test_split(
    range(len(train_df)), test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=train_df["author"]
)

train_subset = train_df.iloc[train_indices].reset_index(drop=True)
val_subset = train_df.iloc[val_indices].reset_index(drop=True)

print(f"Training split: {len(train_subset)}, Validation split: {len(val_subset)}")

# Extract texts and labels with correct pairing
texts = list(train_df["text"].values)
authors = train_df["author"].map({"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}).values

X_train_texts = [texts[i] for i in train_indices]
y_train = authors[train_indices]
X_val_texts = [texts[i] for i in val_indices]
y_val = authors[val_indices]


# Enhanced text cleaning function - preserves literary style patterns
def clean_text(text):
    text = str(text)
    # Normalize whitespace - collapse multiple spaces to single space
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    # Handle ellipsis - convert triple dots to normalized pattern
    text = text.replace("...", " ... ")
    # Convert various dashes to standard hyphen (preserves one-space-around-hyphen patterns)
    text = text.replace("---", " -- ")
    text = text.replace("--", " - ")
    # Preserve apostrophes for contractions and possession (don't remove them!)
    # Normalize some common punctuation
    text = text.replace("?", ". ")
    text = text.replace("!", ". ")
    text = text.replace('"', "'")
    return text.strip()


X_train_clean = [clean_text(t) for t in X_train_texts]
X_val_clean = [clean_text(t) for t in X_val_texts]

# Word n-grams (original settings preserved)
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=10000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=2, max_df=0.95, sublinear_tf=True
)
X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_clean)
X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_val_clean)
print(f"Word TF-IDF features: {X_train_word.shape[1]}")

# Character unigrams vectorizer
char_unigram_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer=lambda x: list(x),
    max_features=5000,
    min_df=5,
    max_df=0.92,
    sublinear_tf=False,
)
X_train_char_uni = char_unigram_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_clean)
X_val_char_uni = char_unigram_vectorizer.transform(X_val_clean)
print(f"Character unigram TF-IDF features: {X_train_char_uni.shape[1]}")

# Character bigrams vectorizer
char_bigram_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer=lambda x: [x[i : i + 2] for i in range(len(x) - 1)],
    max_features=5000,
    min_df=5,
    max_df=0.92,
    sublinear_tf=False,
)
X_train_char_bi = char_bigram_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_clean)
X_val_char_bi = char_bigram_vectorizer.transform(X_val_clean)
print(f"Character bigram TF-IDF features: {X_train_char_bi.shape[1]}")

# Character trigrams vectorizer
char_trigram_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer=lambda x: [x[i : i + 3] for i in range(len(x) - 2)],
    max_features=5000,
    min_df=5,
    max_df=0.90,
    sublinear_tf=False,
)
X_train_char_tri = char_trigram_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_clean)
X_val_char_tri = char_trigram_vectorizer.transform(X_val_clean)
print(f"Character trigram TF-IDF features: {X_train_char_tri.shape[1]}")

# Character quadgrams vectorizer (NEW ENHANCEMENT)
char_quadgram_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer=lambda x: [x[i : i + 4] for i in range(len(x) - 3)],
    max_features=5000,
    min_df=5,
    max_df=0.88,
    sublinear_tf=False,
)
X_train_char_quad = char_quadgram_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_clean)
X_val_char_quad = char_quadgram_vectorizer.transform(X_val_clean)
print(f"Character quadgram TF-IDF features: {X_train_char_quad.shape[1]}")

# Combine all character-level features
X_train_chars = hstack(
    [X_train_char_uni, X_train_char_bi, X_train_char_tri, X_train_char_quad]
)
X_val_chars = hstack([X_val_char_uni, X_val_char_bi, X_val_char_tri, X_val_char_quad])
print(f"Combined character features: {X_train_chars.shape[1]}")

# Combine word and all character features
X_train_combined = hstack([X_train_word, X_train_chars])
X_val_combined = hstack([X_val_word, X_val_chars])

print(f"Total combined TF-IDF features: {X_train_combined.shape[1]}")

# Train base logistic regression classifier with balanced weights
base_classifier = LogisticRegression(
    C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, class_weight="balanced", n_jobs=-1
)
base_classifier.fit(X_train_combined, y_train)

# Apply probability calibration using sigmoid method (consistent with successful prior experiments)
calibrated_classifier = CalibratedClassifierCV(
    base_classifier, cv=5, method="sigmoid", n_jobs=-1
)
calibrated_classifier.fit(X_train_combined, y_train)

# Get calibrated validation probabilities
val_probs = calibrated_classifier.predict_proba(X_val_combined)

# Compute validation log-loss (competition metric)
validation_logloss = log_loss(y_val, val_probs)
print(
    f"Validation Log-Loss (enhanced char features with quadgrams): {validation_logloss:.6f}"
)

# Generate test predictions
print("\nGenerating test predictions...")
test_texts = [clean_text(t) for t in test_df["text"].values]

test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(test_texts)
test_chars = hstack(
    [
        char_unigram_vectorizer.transform(test_texts),
        char_bigram_vectorizer.transform(test_texts),
        char_trigram_vectorizer.transform(test_texts),
        char_quadgram_vectorizer.transform(test_texts),
    ]
)
X_test_combined = hstack([test_word, test_chars])

test_probs = calibrated_classifier.predict_proba(X_test_combined)

# Create submission dataframe with correct column order
submission_cols = ["id", "EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"].values,
        "EAP": test_probs[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_probs[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_probs[:, 2],
    }
)

# Ensure submission path exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(
    f"\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv with {len(submission_df)} rows"
)
print("Done!")
